name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Accordion
description: Adds an Accordion/FAQ block type driven by jQuery UI Accordion.
project_description:
Extra Block Types: Accordion module provides ability to add a block with Accordion / FAQ.

 EBT allows to choose styles for Accordion and FAQ via UI.

 Demo: EBT Accordion / FAQ 

 EBT modules provide ability to add different blocks in Layout Builder in few clicks. You can install separate block types from this bunch of EBT modules:

 
 EBT Accordion / FAQ 
 EBT Basic Button 
 EBT Block 
 EBT Bootstrap Button 
 EBT Call to Action 
 EBT Carousel 
 EBT Countdown 
 EBT Counter 
 EBT Hero 
 EBT Image 
 EBT Image Gallery 
 EBT Micromodal 
 EBT Quote 
 EBT Slick Slider 
 EBT Slideshow 
 EBT Stats 
 EBT Tabs 
 EBT Text 
 EBT Tiles 
 EBT Timeline 
 EBT Video 
 EBT Video and Image Gallery 
 EBT Views 
 EBT Webform 
 EBT Webform Popup 
 
 All EBT block types contain default widget for EBT blocks, which has Design options for:

 
 CSS Box (margins, paddings, borders) 
 Background using color, image (including parallax and cover), video (Youtube) 
 Edge to edge, Container width 
 
 More about EBT blocks read on EBT Core module page:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/ebt_core
